title: Feta and Dill Chicken Salad with Lemon Yoghurt
changes_from_base: Half the mayonnaise becomes Greek yoghurt, dill and lemon zest lead the herbs, and cubes of feta replace the celery crunch.
summary: Tender poached chicken folded through a lemony yoghurt and mayonnaise dressing with dill, parsley, spring onions and cubes of salty feta.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Poach the chicken
steps.text: Lay the breasts and bay leaf in a saucepan with cold water to cover by 2 cm. Heat until small bubbles break the surface, then cover, take off the heat and leave about 15 min, until 74 °C in the centre. Cool, then cut into 1 cm cubes.

steps.title: Mix the dressing
steps.text: In the bowl, stir the mayonnaise, yoghurt, herbs, lemon zest and juice, salt and pepper together.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Fold in the chicken and spring onions, then the feta, gently so the cubes stay whole. Chill 20 min and serve on lettuce leaves, in wraps or in sandwiches.

tips: Cut the feta into neat cubes and fold gently so it stays whole.
Poaching at a bare simmer keeps the chicken juicy.
Taste before salting: feta varies a lot in saltiness.
storage: Keeps covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Not suitable for freezing. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
